list.title: Plans
list.description: What members pay and what they get.
list.emptyMessage: A plan is what people buy: its price, how long it lasts, and what they get.

editor.membersOnPlan: {count, plural, one {# member is} other {# members are}} on this plan. Changes apply to them from their next period.
editor.createNote: Nothing is sold yet. This only adds the plan.
editor.createInvalid: Add a name and a price to add the plan
editor.stopped: {name} is no longer sold. Current members keep what they have.
editor.notSellingNotice: Not selling. Current members keep what they have.

name.title: Name and description
name.description: What the plan is called at the counter and on a member's card.
name.nameHelp: A name members will recognise, like Family or Friend of the Museum.
name.descLabel: What members get, in one line
name.descHelp: One short sentence. Shown at the counter.
name.nameRequired: Give the plan a name members will recognise.

price.title: Price
price.description: What a member pays, and how often.
price.help_lifetime: Members pay {price} once and keep the plan for life.

visits.title: Visits
visits.description: How often members can come in, and for what.
visits.helpUnlimited: Members can visit as often as they like.
visits.help_monthly: {count, plural, one {# visit} other {# visits}} each month.
visits.help_quarterly: {count, plural, one {# visit} other {# visits}} every 3 months.
visits.help_annual: {count, plural, one {# visit} other {# visits}} each year.
visits.help_lifetime: {count, plural, one {# visit} other {# visits}} in all.
visits.invalid: Enter at least 1 visit, or choose Unlimited.
visits.whichLabel: Which bookings a visit is for
visits.helpEvery: A visit can be used on any booking.
visits.helpSome: A visit can only be used on the bookings you tick.
visits.pickLabel: Bookings a visit can be used on

discount.title: Member price
discount.description: Money off for members, on top of what the plan includes.
discount.helpEverything: The discount applies to every booking.
discount.helpSome: The discount applies only to the bookings you tick.

covers.title: Who it covers
covers.description: One person, or a family or group sharing the plan.
covers.helpGroup: Up to {count} people share one membership.
covers.guestsHelpNone: Members can't bring guests for free.
covers.guestsHelp: {count, plural, one {# free guest} other {# free guests}} each period.

renewal.title: Renewal
renewal.description: What happens when a period ends.
renewal.helpOn: The membership starts a new period when the old one ends.
renewal.helpOff: The member has to buy it again when it ends.
renewal.noticeLabel: Remind them this many days before
renewal.noticeHelp: {count, plural, one {Members are told # day before it renews.} other {Members are told # days before it renews.}}
renewal.noticeHelpZero: Members aren't reminded before it renews.
